run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the k-th prime factor of a given number n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input pairs of n and k values
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that computes the k-th prime factor using trial division
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases where k is zero or negative
review_f_gold: review the f_gold algorithm for finding the k-th prime factor of a number
